title: maggots for brain
journal: Today wasn't particularly good or bad. I woke up late, rushed through my morning, and spent most of the day working. There were moments when I felt productive and moments when I questioned whether any of this matters. On the way home, I listened to music and stared out the window. For some reason, that quiet time made me think about how quickly everything changes. A year ago, I was worried about completely different things. Maybe that's comforting. Maybe it means the problems I'm stressing about now won't seem so important someday either.
reflection: It sounds like a day of mixed feelings, where the quiet moments of reflection helped bring a comforting perspective to life's constant changes. It's good to find reassurance in knowing that today's worries, like those of a year ago, are likely to fade with time.

title: My first project
journal: today I completed version 1.0 of memoir my own full stack project. I always wanted to have one, but I would just do frontend and than just forget about it but not this time. I know its not that visually appealing or it has a lot of things that need fixing but im happy that I thought of an idea and bought it to life. Now probably I won't do any more full stack projects because I have other things and interests to pursue but this project feels like a dream come true. younger me would be happy and proud of me for finally finishing a project. ill keep working on this project with the things ill learn and give it a proper professional finish it deserves. But right now I'll leave it a little unprofessional a little cutesy for the younger me. im proud of myself.
reflection: What an incredible achievement! It's truly inspiring to see you not only bring a long-held idea to life but also overcome past challenges to complete your full-stack project. Your pride is palpable, and that sense of fulfillment and making your younger self proud is the most beautiful reward.
